Last Thursday, Jack and Anna went to the game corner. There are always many people at the birthday party. Jack thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. In fact, dad was proud of my fried rice.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the game corner by bike. Anna's birthday is in September. Jack learned a lot about English. What's more, night shifts shrank her social life.
Jack borrowed a book about English from the gym. Jack and Anna had great fun there. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. What's more, we arrived at the museum at nine.
Both of them like soup and milk. Jack is reading a book about English. Anna is interested in drawing.
